headline: Site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school, plus Riverfront Commission appointments and damage claims.
summary: The council will consider giving the Pawtucket School Committee site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school. It will also act on Riverfront Commission appointments, damage claims, and a change to the September 9, 2026 meeting dates.
items: Publication from Megan Khatchadourian, Assistant to the Director, RI ACLU, on remote access to public meetings
Reappointment of Jennifer Kilsey, Cultural Affairs Program Coordinator, to the Arts Panel Review Committee
Resolution giving site control of 142 South Bend Street to the Pawtucket School Committee for a new unified high school, referred to the City Property Committee
Claim by Juan Hernandez for $680.96 (pothole) and claim by Bernard Donald Grossi, Jr. for $140.00 (tow), referred to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits
Personal injury and vehicle damage claims by Zachary Fulford, Margarita Cruz Serrano, Makayla Gomes, and Donnell Mitchell, referred to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust
Traffic control issues on Rice Street (stop signs)
Confirmation of reappointment of Michael A. Lafond to the Riverfront Commission
Confirmation of appointment of David Sisson to the Riverfront Commission
Resolution moving the Board of License Commissioners and City Council meetings from Wednesday, September 9, 2026 to Thursday, September 10, 2026
Claims returned by the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits: Christine King for $250.00 (pothole) and Ashley Mazzucco for $281.27 (tire)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 2nd Floor Temporary Council Chambers, 100 Freight Street
